name: v0.4.12 — Smashlist cleanup + Receipts font
releaseNotes:
• Smashlist: the store name now headlines each card (bigger than the items), and it's no longer repeated on every line — each item shows its estimated price instead. Item count reads "2 items".
• Receipts: store name + amount now use one consistent font.

Uninstall the old app first, then install this one fresh.
